name: Walnuts

low.description: About 10 walnut halves or 1/4 cup chopped

siboNotes: Well-tolerated on SIBO diets as they're FODMAP-free and provide beneficial fats that don't feed bacterial overgrowth.
preparationTips: Store in refrigerator or freezer to prevent rancidity
Toast lightly to enhance flavor and crispness
Chop just before using to maintain freshness
Soak overnight if digestive sensitivity exists
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of protein and fiber
Rich in antioxidants and vitamin E
